strings.en: I heard from the Dangaioh Team... PLS Black Point...
It seems a mysterious asteroid has settled there. What's more...
it clearly intends to attack...
Oops... Looks like he already found out.
And Captain Bright told us not to worry Commander Hazuki, too.
I bet Pai let it slip.
Don't blame her... He'd have found out eventually.
About this plant planet...
I truly apologize... Commander.
It's not that I was deliberately hiding it. It's just...
I understand, Captain Bright. For now, what matters more
is figuring out what that plant planet really is... and our countermeasures.
Quite right. I'll transfer the data to you.
There are no major problems so far, but it has certainly
attacked our survey team... with humanoid weapons.
What about the other enemy forces?
Most factions have quieted down, but we can't let our guard down yet.
We've also confirmed reports of new forces, like the Crossbone Vanguard,
who champion Cosmo Aristocratism.
A new enemy force in space, and on the ground, Hyakki and Mykene
machines we thought we'd beaten are at Jaburo... It'll stay rough a while.
No doubt. It's a troublesome situation. Commander Hazuki...
We'll have to leave the Neo Zeon forces that descended to you.
We're counting on you.
Leave it to us. And I pray for your success too, Captain Bright...!
Likewise to you.
Captain, I've brought them.
Thank you, Lieutenant Emma. So you're... Rom Stol...
I'm surprised. Are you a robot?
...By your understanding... I suppose so. Call me whatever you like.
A mechanical body... Doesn't seem like a cyborg, either.
Speaking of cyborgs... those Megaborg guys
were originally cyborgs built to colonize Mars, right?
But their abilities led them to believe they were a chosen people...
Or rather, perhaps they were given that power to instill that very belief.
...Only the late Dr. Haran would know.
...It seems Earth has its own circumstances...
but we don't concern ourselves with what a body is made of.
Hey, he's on the bridge! Yo, you're Rom Stol, right?
And you are?
Huh... You really do have a mechanical body.
Shinobu! What's gotten into you! Sorry, Rom... He's got no manners.
What, Sara!? I'm just telling the truth!
You're quite popular, Rom.
I'm just rare in this star system. Cronos even has Rock Superhumans...
people with bodies made of stone.
It doesn't bother me.
...More importantly, as a martial artist, I'd like a match with you.
...I'm Ryo Shiba. Our leader's a bit unreliable, but
I'm a member of the Cyber Beast Force. Good to meet you.
I'm Masato Shikibu. Nice to meet you! ...Another alien, huh?
Don't tease him too much, you lot.
Now... Rom, I'd like to get down to business...
You said you'd learned Gyandlar's objective?
Yes. They are...
He really is... a machine.
I figured he was a human wearing some kind of armored mech.
There sure are all kinds of people... out in space.
A mechanical body... Sure, there must be all sorts of life out there, but...
It's kind of... amazing.
Hey, hey, we're not some kind of sideshow, you know?
For us, bodies made of organic matter are the unusual ones.
So we're even, Drill.
That's right, Koji, Sayaka.
Our bodies are just built similarly, but Maria and I are aliens too.
It's not something to be so surprised by.
I know, Daisuke.
Yeah, they're reliable allies, and I'm glad they're all good guys.
Though Jet seems to have a bit of a mouth on him.
Hey, hey, don't build me up just to knock me down.
That's right, Tetsuya, Jun.
Our bodies are just built similarly, but Maria and I are aliens too.
It's not something to be so surprised by.
I know, Daisuke.
They've saved us plenty of times. I don't mean to badmouth them.
But it seems some of them have a mouth on them, just like Tetsuya.
Hey, hey, you mean me?
That just makes him more relatable, doesn't it?
Sounds like everyone's having fun. Hey, what's planet Cronos like?
If I remember... it was attacked by Gyandlar before...
Yeah. We'd better tell you about that.
We chased Gyandlar here after they retreated from planet Cronos...
Gyandlar was after a mystical treasure called Hyper Libido.
Hyper... Libido? Hey, didn't that shady old man say that too?
You mean Dr. Tarsan.
Yes. If I recall, the Doctor said...
Something like it... seems to exist on the third planet... that is, Earth.
On Earth!? Hey, so it's just like that old man said...
On Earth!? ...I see, it's just as Dr. Tarsan said...
Hm? You guys already knew what Gyandlar's after?
...Huh? Where'd Leina go?
Mr. Tenkawa...
Mm... It's OK... I'll protect you, I promise...
Hm? Having a nice dream, are we?
I hate to be a killjoy, but... hey, Akito. Akito Tenkawa!?
...Ai... I'll protect you... I promise... Huh...! Wh-where am I...!?
Ah, you're awake? Looks like you slept well on the moon, Tenkawa.
B-Banjo!? You're OK!? ...And what do you mean, the moon...
I mean the moon. Humans built cities here instead of the rabbits.
...Too hard to follow for someone raised on Mars, Tenkawa...?
Anyway, this is Von Braun, on the moon.
S-so then... we went from Kawasaki to the moon... That's right!
What about that Gekiganger-like robot!? It was gonna self-destruct...
That thing vanished. Getting flung off Earth so suddenly,
maybe it lost any reason to self-destruct.
In any case, I'm so glad you're safe too, Mr. Tenkawa.
Huh...? Who are you people...?
Ah, you're inside the Elshank.
I figured Nergal wouldn't be able to bother you here.
I see... Thank you so much... But wait!
Banjo, are you all right!? If you Boson Jump unprotected...!
Huh? Oh, right... Well, I was in the Daitarn, after all.
But...
I told you I'd be fine. The famous Banjo Haran can do anything...
Or is that laying it on too thick?
Huh? Dunno what you mean, but you're spouting nonsense again, huh?
(...Banjo... Who is this man...?)
...Mr. Tenkawa, I think you should let everyone on Earth know
that you're safe, quickly... I'm sure they're all worried.
No kidding... We were inside the Elshank, but
when the Daitarn and another robot suddenly showed up,
this city went into a bit of a panic, you know?
Right. I've already contacted Garrison on my end.
You should let them know you're safe soon, too.
Shall we, then? I'll show you to the communications room.
Ah, thanks...
(But... after I contact the Nadesico... what do I do then...?)
He must have a lot on his plate... I wonder what he'll do...
Still, Boson Jump, was it?
A single robot doing something like micro-wormhole travel...
That's some amazing technology.
Yes... Though it's sad that it's become a tool of war...
(...A body that can survive a living Boson Jump with no protection...
So Akito Tenkawa really is...)
What do you think about those things, Excellen?
...Hmm, I keep feeling like I hear a voice...
And the Weiss acts up every time, too...
Kyosuke said something similar.
...By the way, what's your relationship with him?
Wow. Wh-what a bold question, Akira.
No, I don't mean it like that... I mean, something in common...
Oh, that's what you mean.
Hmm, back in our academy days... we were both in an accident.
An accident?
...A shuttle accident... There were only two survivors...
Me and Kyosuke.
...What caused it?
Well, that's...
Um... hello.
Hm? ...Oh, you're...
I'm Leina Stol. We've met a few times!
...Um, am I interrupting something?
Not at all. It was a talk that couldn't go anywhere anyway.
Right, Akira?
Y-yeah. What Raideen is trying to tell me...
I haven't found a single clue yet...
Leina, what brings you here?
Well... Jet and the others got caught by everyone...
Ah, they're a curiosity? Their bodies are just made differently.
Seems so. To us, you're the unusual ones, though...
Hmm, but... there is one crucial difference...
Huh?
I'm so jealous that your figure never changes.
...Lately, my clothes have been getting a bit tight...
Oh, that's what you meant. ...Don't worry about bodies being different.
I have the blood of the ancient Mu. Apparently I'm not normal inside.
Huh, the Mu!? Then... does that have to do with something called Mutron...
You know about the Mutron!?
...What Gyandlar is after... is the Mutron...!
Meg?
Oh, yes! ...Stay still!
Aren't you going to the bridge? They're calling for you...
That Jovian Lizard robot we recovered had a cockpit...
and they say the pilot might have gotten into the ship!
R-really?
Oh? You're awfully calm about this, Meg.
There might have been a pilot in it! They said they were unmanned!
Huh? Oh, r-right!
I can't believe someone like that was piloting a Jovian Lizard either!
Someone like that...?
Uh... Oh, n-nothing! I'll go to the bridge after I tidy up... Oh?
Who are these people?
Oh, they're our guests. I ran into them on my way to the bridge...
You must be the comms officer, Megumi Reinard?
I'm Beautiful Tachibana. Call me Beauty.
I'm Reika Sanjo. We were going the Nadesico's way, so we got a ride.
They both work for the man who flew to the moon with Akito,
the famous Banjo Haran. They're his assistants.
"Famous," huh? Honestly, Banjo says that everywhere he goes.
Well, that's just how he is, Beauty. ...Still, I never thought Nergal
would actually let us come aboard.
Oh, this ship's pretty loose about that kind of thing...
But it's awful, isn't it? We'd already set off for the moon,
and now they say an enemy might have slipped aboard...
And they say someone might've been piloting it!? Give me a break...
Oh? Behind you... is that a person?
Ah! No!
Huh!?
Don't move!
Eek!
...Who are you...!?
Th-three women...!? ...Forgive me!
I am of the "Jupiter, Ganymede, Callisto, Europa, and Other Moons
and Asteroids Anti-Earth Union," Assault Superior Human Corps Major
Tsukumo Shiratori!
...Japanese?
For the past century, our nation has built its prosperity on Jupiter...
Hey, haven't you ever read a textbook?
Earth people have never built colonies past Mars.
That is merely your version of history!
Um... he showed up while I was watching Gekiganger...
He says he's a Gekiganger fan. He doesn't seem like a bad person...
Right... Turning in someone who's hurt isn't really my style.
Besides... I'd like to hear what he has to say.
(...That's... kind of surprising.)
Anyway, let's get him somewhere safe. I'm counting on you two.
I don't mind, but...
...Seems we might hear something interesting... Fine, we'll help.
(No doubt about it... This man is that robot's pilot...!
The Jovian Lizards are... humans...!? Seems Banjo was right after all.
I'd better get in touch with Garrison...)
Yes... Hm... I see. That young lady has quite sharp judgment.
Banjo, you wanted to talk...? Oh, he's on a call...
Understood, Captain. We'll be waiting here.
...Yes, he's with me. Until the Nadesico arrives... Yes. Well then...
(The Nadesico? It's coming straight here...!?
What's Yurika thinking...?)
The Elshank's repairs are done, so we can give you all the help you need!
Then, Captain Bright... we'll be waiting for you...
Ah, Tenkawa. Sorry for calling you over and keeping you waiting.
It seems things have gotten more complicated than I thought.
The Nadesico's coming, you said...
Yes. According to Captain Bright, an unidentified asteroid
is approaching Earth.
...The Nadesico is coming up to space to deal with it.
I see...
Londo Bell has also just stopped a colony from falling to Earth.
They'll meet up here, and resupply while they're at it.
Geez, that unit never seems to get a break.
The ones who worry the most always end up the busiest.
You mean... the Ra Cailum's captain?
Who knows? ...Anyway, Tenkawa.
What is it? Why so serious all of a sudden...
Hm? From Garrison...? ...Sorry, Tenkawa.
I've got an incoming call. Hang on.
(...An emergency call. That's unusual for Garrison...)
What...!? Tsukumo!?
Yes, he hasn't been confirmed back aboard. Most likely...
Impossible! Sure, the Tetsujin may have been shot down!
But we confirmed that Tsukumo survived!
Yes, which means... there's only one possibility.
...Tsukumo... Don't tell me he's been taken prisoner by the forces of evil!?
...And that's how it is. I sort of suspected... but reality is cruel.
The Jovian Lizards are... human...!?
Yes. My butler contacted me just now.
The Lizard robot we beat in Kawasaki... seems it had a pilot.
Then the one that tried to self-destruct, too...!?
Most likely.
I overheard a bit of what happened in Kawasaki... Now it all fits together.
Now, let's get to the real reason I called you here.
When the Nadesico gets here... what will you do?
...Well, there's no rush.
You can decide before the Nadesico arrives.
But... let me tell you just this one thing.
Everyone has a place where they belong.
But that place... isn't always a peaceful one.
Banjo...
The big military facility on the moon is Anaheim Electronics,
but Nergal Heavy Industries has a dock here too.
I arranged for them to send over a new model... but we're short on pilots.
This war... will end someday, one way or another.
I don't think it'd be all that hard to keep running until then.
But if you're unsure... maybe you should wait there for the Nadesico
for the time being, don't you think?
